preconditions.description: The length of the interview string n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have a length equal to n and consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the interview string with all filler words replaced by '***'.
